signatures.description: Implement a stratified Datalog evaluator that returns derived facts together with provenance polynomials over an arbitrary commutative semiring, so one engine answers why-provenance, bag multiplicities, and min-cost, including negation and aggregation strata. Support incremental maintenance on base-fact insert and delete where a deletion retracts exactly the derivations that depended on it (the over-deletion problem) instead of recomputing the program. Prove exactness: a fact's provenance equals the semiring sum over all its rule derivations, and incrementally maintained results are byte-identical to full recomputation after every batch.
